def snap(fr, tag):
    seg = fr.segmentation
    out = []
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('W','G','O','p') and 8 <= n['pixels'] <= 25:
            b = n['boundary']
            rs = [p[0] for p in b]; cs = [p[1] for p in b]
            out.append((n['color'], n['pixels'], (min(rs)+max(rs))//2, (min(cs)+max(cs))//2, n['children']))
    print(tag, out)
